decision_conditions:
The
development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three
years from the date of this permission.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted, shall match those used on the external surfaces of existing building and as specified on the planning application form and supporting documents which form part the approved plans list.

No window(s) and/or door(s) other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted, shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Site Location and Block Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-101;</li><li>Site Survey Plan entitled Drawing No: 12721 – T;</li><li>Existing Ground and Roof Floor Plans entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-102;</li><li>Existing Elevations Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-103;</li><li>Proposed Site Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-104;</li><li>&nbsp;Proposed Ground and Roof Floor Plans entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-105;</li><li>&nbsp;Proposed Elevations Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-106;</li><li>&nbsp;Proposed Sections Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP3-107;</li><li>&nbsp;Proposed Site Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP2-108;</li><li>Proposed Area Plan entitled Drawing No: PSH-AP2-109;</li><li>&nbsp;Design Access and Heritage Statement received July 10th, 2024;</li></ul>
description: Single storey side extension incorporating porch with front entrance steps; single storey side extension;  alterations to roof; re-location of main entrance to front; external alterations (demolition of stores to side)
